messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-45678 fired for service inference-gateway — 5xx rate spike in us-west1. Alert: 5xx_rate = 1.8% (threshold 1.0%). PD: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-45678

alex: Acked. I'm on call — looking at Grafana now.

jamie: also seeing elevated kv-cache evictions around 2026-03-17T03:45Z, looks like eviction bursts correlate with 5xx spike.

alex: Customers: subset of streaming generate requests failing with 502/504. Support thread shows ~2% of active sessions in us-west1.

ryan: I'm kicking a quick scale-up of gateway pool and adding headroom. Command: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/gateway --replicas=8`

jamie: pulling logs from the gateway sidecars, spammy errors: 
```
ERROR inference.gateway: failed to fetch context from kv-cache key=ctx_abc123: context deadline exceeded
WARN kvproxy: eviction rate spike: 120/s
```

maria: if kvproxy is thrashing, prefix cache warmup might help. Can we enable prefix-only warmup for us-west1 routing shard?

alex: scaling is in. Also bumping KV_CACHE_TTL to reduce cold misses: setting KV_CACHE_TTL=30m on gateway env for us-west1.

ryan: pushed a rollback of the recent auth-proxy bump (v1.24.0 -> v1.23.9) as a canary to us-west1 to eliminate regressed behavior. Rollout started.

prod-ops: Status page note drafted: partial degradation for inference APIs (us-west1). Impact: streaming and some chat integrations. Flagging P2 unless customers escalate.

alex: Handoff: jamie will take mitigation + postmortem lead. I'll monitor and support scaling if needed.

jamie: Taking it — will watch 5xx rate and kv evictions for 15m, followed by rollback verification and postmortem outline. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-45678 acknowledged by alex; escalated to primary oncall jamie.
